verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right flow: logo, sale ribbon, product, then the headline, subcopy and CTA block. Its flaws are that the ribbon is shrunk to a small tag floating apart from the product, the logo and the left third feel sparse, and the headline sits over the decorative circle. B makes the headline huge and crams it into the bottom-left so it nearly touches the bottom edge, and it reduces the product to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the top-right corner against the circle. The ribbon in B floats in the middle and the reading order is scattered (logo, ribbon, product, subcopy and CTA all compete), so the key product imagery becomes trivial.
